title: Umbrellas
body:
# ☂️ Survival Umbrellas Datapack

This datapack adds **7 craftable umbrella variants** to Minecraft, designed for practical survival use and controlled mobility.

## 📜 Features
- **7 Different Umbrellas**  
  - Each umbrella has its own crafting recipe.  
  - Fully obtainable in **Survival Mode**.

- **Slow Falling Effect**  
  - While holding an umbrella in either hand, you will **descend slowly**.

- **No Fall Damage**  
  - Fall damage is completely negated as long as the umbrella is:
    - Held in the **main hand**,  
    - Held in the **off-hand**, or  
    - Worn on the **head**.

- **Custom Crafting Recipes**  
  - All umbrellas use balanced, survival-friendly recipes.

## 🎨 Optional Visual Upgrade
For improved visuals, you can install the additional **[resource pack](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/umbrellas-models)**.  
It provides enhanced umbrella models and textures for a cleaner and more immersive appearance.

## 🙏 Credits
Special thanks to **Akulich** for the umbrella models from Planet Minecraft:  
https://www.planetminecraft.com/texture-pack/umbrellas/  

The models are used with permission for modification and publication within this project.

## 🔧 Compatibility
- Works in **Vanilla Minecraft** (no mods required).  
- Fully functional in **singleplayer and multiplayer**.
